# Lisbon Budget Trip Snapshot

A 3-day Lisbon plan for 2 adults, centered on a budget-friendly stay near the city center, walkable sightseeing, affordable food, and one indoor backup for rain.
Budget target: **€900 total excluding flights**; this plan keeps estimated spend around **€820–€900** depending on hotel rates and food choices.

## Recommended Stay and 3-Day Cost Plan

| Item | Estimate | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Hotel (3 nights) | €360–€480 | Affordable central-area hotel or guesthouse |
| Food & drinks | €180–€240 | Mix of cafés, tascas, and one nicer dinner |
| Transit | €20–€35 | Metro, tram, and occasional rideshare |
| Sightseeing | €60–€110 | Mostly free/low-cost attractions |
| Indoor backup activity | €20–€40 | Museum or market-style visit |
| Buffer | €80–€120 | Snacks, extra coffee, small surprises |
| Total | **€720–€1,025** | Best value target: **€820–€900** |

### Best Hotel Zone
- **Baixa / Chiado / Rossio edge** is the best fit for your budget and location goal.
- You’ll be close to metro, trams, restaurants, and major sights without needing many taxis.
- Look for a simple 3-star hotel or guesthouse with breakfast included if possible.

## 3-Day Lisbon Itinerary and Budget

### Day 1: Historic Center + Sunset Views
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, and do a relaxed walk through **Baixa** and **Rossio**.
- Afternoon: Visit **Rua Augusta Arch** area, then head to **Santa Justa Lift** surroundings and **Chiado**.
- Evening: Take the tram or a short uphill walk to a sunset viewpoint like **Miradouro de São Pedro de Alcântara**.
- Food: Budget lunch at a local café, then dinner at a traditional **tasca** with grilled fish or bifana sandwiches.
- Estimated cost for 2: **€120–€170**

### Day 2: Alfama, Castle Area, and Local Eats
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Explore **Alfama** on foot, including narrow lanes, viewpoints, and the cathedral area.
- Afternoon: Visit **Castelo de São Jorge** or choose the outside viewpoints if you want to save more.
- Evening: Try a casual **fado**-style dinner only if the price fits; otherwise keep it simple with wine, petiscos, and dessert.
- Food: Start with pastries and coffee, then a low-cost lunch in Alfama, and seafood or petiscos for dinner.
- Estimated cost for 2: **€150–€220**

### Day 3: Belém + Indoor Rain Backup
- Morning: Head to **Belém** for riverside sightseeing and a famous pastry stop.
- Afternoon: If the weather is clear, walk the riverfront and visit one major site; if it rains, switch to an indoor museum visit.
- Evening: Return to the center for a final easy dinner and a short stroll.
- Food: **Pastéis de Belém** or a nearby pastry stop, then a casual dinner in the city center.
- Indoor backup: **Museu Nacional do Azulejo** or **MAAT** if you want a weather-proof cultural stop.
- Estimated cost for 2: **€130–€190**

## Budget-Friendly Hotel Picks Near the Center

Option 1: **Central guesthouse in Baixa/Rossio** | Best value if you want to walk everywhere | Usually **€110–€160/night**
Action: [Button: Search stays](https://www.booking.com/city/pt/lisbon.html)

Option 2: **Simple 3-star hotel in Chiado edge** | Slightly nicer comfort, still central | Usually **€130–€180/night**
Action: [Button: Compare hotels](https://www.hotels.com/de1066931/hotels-lisbon-portugal/)

Option 3: **Budget hotel near metro in Avenida/Marquês area** | Often cheaper, easy transit access | Usually **€90–€140/night**
Action: [Button: View options](https://www.agoda.com/city/lisbon-pt.html)

## Simple Packing List

- Light walking shoes with good grip
- Small umbrella or compact rain jacket
- Layered clothing for cool mornings and warmer afternoons
- Reusable water bottle
- Phone charger and power bank
- Day bag or crossbody bag
- Sunscreen and sunglasses
- Basic toiletries
- One smarter outfit for dinner
- Copies of travel documents and payment cards

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Plan routes](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Lisbon+Baixa+Chiado+Alfama+Bel%C3%A9m)
Action: [Button: Check weather](https://www.accuweather.com/en/pt/lisbon/274087/weather-forecast/274087)

## Sources

- Lisbon tourism overview: https://www.visitlisboa.com/
- Museum backup options: https://museudoazulejo.pt/ and https://www.maat.pt/
